authority.statement: The notice and locator grant no permission or authority.

boundaries: This notice may not modify or authorize modification of product code.
Do not select a persistence, database, ORM, broker, workflow-runtime, or deployment provider; provider selection remains an L4 owner decision.
Do not publish, release, deploy, commit, push, or claim production readiness from this notice.
The notice and its locator are communication evidence only and grant no authority.
Reconciliation must preserve D45-D49, D36-D44, domainspec-durable-recovery@2, and the owner admission semantics exactly.
key_points: The bounded product lane covers L0-L3 only: provider-neutral D45-D49 architecture and language profiles, executable binding machinery, TypeScript/Python/Rust realizations, and bounded CLI generation and observation.
The admitted architecture remains domainspec-durable-recovery@2; its concern-specific contracts and explicit bindings are preserved without a universal code-level Port abstraction.
L4 is excluded: no persistence provider, database, ORM, broker, durable dispatcher, deployment topology, or production runtime is selected or implemented by this lane.
Candidate-local validation evidence must not be restated as synchronized governance, publication, release, deployment, or production readiness.
